GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began well. Rolled fwd to lead on rail by 1 length early . Held lead on inside midrace until joined in front @ 700m. Pushed to quicken @ 550m & pressured Two Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Boxed on until weakened in last 200m. Rider - didn't run out 2200m. Vetted clear. # Led & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated mount led & travelled comfortably in e&m stages. Rdr stated passing 600m she asked mount to improve & it responded only fairly before peaking on run approaching 200m & weakening to line. Rdr stated mount was fresh for today's event & its race fitness may have told on its performance. Rdr added that she believes a query remains on her mount's ability to run out a strong 2200m. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 2 Lengths Ridden Along Went Forward = Lead Four Wide of 4 out of Straight Crossed Lead 2 Lengths x 1600m, Joined x 600m and Soon After Couldn'T Go On - was Four Wide 1st 800m but was # weak once beat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced wide until working forward to the lead near the 1600m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Blundered on jumping then Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by half a length settling down, led out and crossed to 2 Lengths Lead on fence at the 1800m, joined at 1200m, Headed 1050m, railed back up to joint Lead at 800m, same past turn, Headed rounding turn and Lost Ground in Straight # weakened/no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Blundered on jumping. Near the 1300m, put in an awkward stride and became unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok slotted across one x one 2 Lengths (1500m), no change 800, 3 Wide 700 making move Soon After , 2nd 400 all out though leader Going Well , whip, no response held Ground only # good trip/ev chance
Jumped okay & Went Forward to a half length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led by a head turning, Headed Straightening Up and weakened a little down the Straight # faded in Straight

Jumped only fairly, 3 Wide rounding first turn and Settled Down 3.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 4.5 Lengths rail turning, shifted off fence Straightening Up and Made Some Ground late in straight. (Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) # ran on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 100m was steadied out around heels to continue to improve.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Rolled fwd & rolled to lead on rail by 1.5L early . Held lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken @ 600m. Joined @ 450m.& pressured =lead Two Wide on home turn. Weakened Two Wide in straight. # Led & weakened

Jumped Ok , wanted to go faster in front 1000m, settled better in the middle stages, looked beaten when headed soon after Straightening Up but responded to riding last 200m and regained lead for gutsy on pace win # gutsy on pace win
